_what: Rows of old trillion records/marketplace-screens.json at old-trillion-before-worker-retire, copied whole for the screen host tests (src/tool_runs/page_routes/tests.rs): the first-load screens, Look and one decision.

tools.label: Get started
tools.job: Show the setup steps this account still has to finish
tools.description: A screen: the required setup steps with their live checked progress, the way to connect an AI, and what is left before the rest of Trillion opens.

tools.label: Progress
tools.job: Show what is waiting for this account's answer and the pursuits it is working toward
tools.description: A screen: the decisions waiting for an answer, the pursuits this account is working toward with where each stands, and its Space pursuits; with pursuit, that one pursuit's detail.

tools.label: Plan
tools.job: Show the plans this account can choose, what it holds and what it used this month
tools.description: A screen: the plans this account can choose at the price its browser was shown, the one it holds, its free count, the spots it pays for, and what it used this month.

tools.label: Connections
tools.job: Show the accounts this account owns and those shared with it, and the services to connect
tools.description: A screen: the accounts this account owns and the account details shared with it, a page of each, the services it can connect, its computers and what they did, and its saved logins.

tools.label: Look
tools.job: Show how Trillion looks and feels on every screen this account opens it on: the look it wears, how panes size and snap, and how each moment feels
tools.description: A screen with no facts to read: three sections that lend the shared parts that keep their own choice in the account's records (Screen look, Panes, Feel). Running it lists the looks this account can wear and the one worn, as tool:screen-looks does.

layout.title: Look
layout.lead: How Trillion looks and feels on every screen you open it on.

sections.heading: Screen look
sections.body: Choose a look. Changes appear right away.

sections.heading: Panes
sections.body: Drag the edge to feel it. Changes appear right away.

sections.heading: Feel
sections.body: How each moment feels: the touch, the sound and the motion. Press play to feel one.

tools.label: Decision
tools.job: Show one of this account's decisions: what was decided, its results and notes, what it rested on and how it was worked through
tools.description: A screen, opened with a decision's id (?id=): what was decided and why, where you stand on it, its actions, results and notes, what it rested on and how it was worked through, with your answer box when one is waiting.

send.confirm: Remove this decision? This cannot be undone.

then.heading: Where this decision aims to take you

else.title: This decision is gone
else.lead: It was removed, so there is nothing more to show here.
